known_defects.defect: The two purely vertical hops (cli->api and queue->worker) have only a 2-cell traversable path, so their dots oscillate between two adjacent cells instead of travelling. This is the renderer's constant-rate dot on a short route, not a detour or a lost relation.
known_defects.evidence: captures/v1-frames-direct.txt: the cli->api dot visits only (36,11) and (36,12) across frames 0..20 while the gap between the CLI box (bottom border y9) and the API gateway box (top border y14) is four rows y10..13; the queue->worker dot likewise visits only (23,27) and (23,28) between the Job queue box (bottom y25) and the Worker pool box (top y30).
known_defects.attempted_fix: attempt 3 reserved a layout slot to offset the Worker pool, turning both hops into elbows; it was rejected because it introduced 1 ambiguous label owner and a 51-cell forced wrap on e5 (attempts/v1-attempt3-tb-offset.check.txt). Budget was then exhausted.
known_defects.not_fixed_because: spec attempts exhausted (3 of 3 used); the defect does not hide a relationship, a label, or a direction.

known_defects.defect: The `client` group's colour family is the same gruvbox accent rgb(216,166,87) that the viewer uses for selection, so CLI's selected border is indistinguishable from its unselected border in the --select-all frame.
known_defects.evidence: evidence/v1/v1-ansi.ansi CLI border rgb(216,166,87) at x35..39,y6..9; evidence/v1/v1-selected.ansi CLI border is the same rgb(216,166,87) at the same cells, while the other five boxes switch from their group colour to rgb(216,166,87).
known_defects.not_fixed_because: the palette assignment gives the accent to the first group; avoiding it would mean inventing or merging a semantic group, which the skill forbids. Selection of the other five nodes is still proven.

known_defects.defect: `origins: 6/6` and the capture agree only if the 1-cell port stem is excluded from a route: at 0 ms every dot sits on the second drawn cell of its route, and the stem cell adjacent to the source box is never traversed.
